name: Ashish Kumar Singh
tagline: Systems Programmer & Backend Engineer • CS @ NIT Agartala
bio: I am a 3rd-year Computer Science undergraduate at NIT Agartala (CGPA 8.94). I focus on low-level systems programming in C++, Linux kernel interfaces like /proc, and distributed telemetry infrastructure. I built Trackit, a real-time Linux system monitor that polls at 500ms intervals with a 1.3% CPU footprint, and Panopteez, a 5-node distributed ingestion pipeline. Currently President of the Data Science & AI Club at NIT Agartala.
